rules: Do not fabricate capabilities, pricing, regulatory status, partnerships, market share, turnaround time, or APAC availability.
Prefer competitor primary sources for product claims.
Separate verified facts, inference, and uncertainty.
Record publication/announcement date and effective/launch date when available.
Only create an update when it is new or materially changed.
Map each meaningful signal to CENTOGENE product/capability and sales implications.
Use Taiwan/APAC sources when the development concerns regional access or competition.
